parsed.why: No trans-specific offence or police targeting documented; same-sex conduct long decriminalised. But no marker-change route yields documented frontier document disagreement, no gender-identity protections, and only invisibility/hostility signals, not acceptance.

Functioning protections remain, yet biological-sex rules impose tier-1 universal exposure: birth-sex strip-searching, single-sex service and ward exclusion, birth-sex prison placement, and a documented ward death before that regime.

Parent regime imposes no criminalisation and adds hate-crime and anti-discrimination cover; territory subtracts via isolation, no local specialist care and religious-cultural stigma, plus documented birth-sex custody placement.

Sodomy repealed but morality/indecency articles are actively enforced against cross-dressing and LGBTQ people, non-citizens face deportation, and the interior ministry screens out and bans effeminate foreigners at entry, with no recourse.

Border document regime refuses and can permanently bar applicants whose sex is doubted, executive threat-framing, facilities bans and criminal bathroom use in some states, custody abuses; offset by protections and enforceable litigation in others.
